verdict.reasoning: Printed page 244 (PDF p266) shows the 13.8.1 term table with two rows: constant-entry -> 13.9, Constant entry; screen-description-entry -> 13.15, Screen description entry. The markdown (page-266.md lines 17-21) has the first row in a pipe table and the second as a loose line right after it, 'screen-description-entry 13.15, Screen description entry'. Every word of the PDF row is there, in order, beside the table, and the term-to-subclause mapping reads the same. The quotes in the claim are accurate. The difference is markdown table formatting only, which is one of the listed grounds for rejection. No content is missing or changed.
